reviews.text:
Very efficient and caring
Highly recommend
Always great service. Jaden always does a great job with my my taz man. He always comes out looking fresh and happy as can be. Couldnt ask for more.
Gabby never disappoints!!
Highly recommended.

The Cookies N Clean team is always so wonderful with my dogs. They always come home beautifully trimmed, clean as a whistle, and ridiculously happy. I can always tell they’ve been loved on  their entire visit! The prices for grooming are very reasonable, and after two years of taking my dogs there, I have yet to have a bad visit. I would definitely recommend Cookies N Clean For your Dog Grooming needs!
Love the way our Cavapoo looks after visiting Cookies and Clean!!
Did a great job with Max.
Staff was friendly and professional.    The dogs nails were trimmed nicely.
Gabby always does a great job grooming our Kaitlyn
Fabulous service. I have a nervous dog but Cookies and clean never have any issues getting my furball shaved. Great work and their Mobil van makes it easy.
Super expensive. We came in for a nail trim and shave out the bottom of the paw pads for $40. That's just crazy, highway robbery. Check prices before you go, because I didnt
Mabel our golden was well taken care of and looked beautiful after grooming. Nice job! Mabel was anxious at her first visit but now does well and enjoys it. Thanks cookies and clean!

I really appreciate the staff at Cookies and Clean. They are always helpful and they enjoy seeing your pet. It is a quaint little business. It's awesome that you can wash your pet yourself or you can have them do that and other services. They will even travel to you!
$20 for a nail trim is a great deal. Service was excellent!
Kayla did a fabulous job with Sousuke both times I have taken him in. He is a foster cat for us. And we appreciate the love and care given to him by Kayla and the other staff as well.
This place is the best. Easy scheduling. Top drawer service. Ask for Jaden if you have a kitty. They’ll be happy you did.
Very good, Sage did excellent!
I had to bring my cat in to get groomed due to a messy mishap, and I was so happy to receive him back happy and not traumatized. We will definitely return for our other animals.
I love bringing my golden retriever here! Staff is very welcoming and Sage always does a great job. Pricing is not bad either. Would 10/10 recommend
Caring professional good value service
Amazing service!! Daisha is so friendly, and extremely gentle with my cat. Explained everything and did a fantastic job!! Definitely recommend the Mobil grooming service.
Daisha did a great job with my 2 dogs.
We did the mobile grooming service. Daisha was very communicative and listened to what our dog needed, and gave him a great first experience being groomed! Pricing was very reasonable as well.

We had a fantastic experience with Cookies N Clean Mobile Dog Grooming! Jaden was punctual, professional, and provided excellent service. Thanos and Marvel did great with her, and they both looked amazing afterward! We loved the convenience of having them groomed right at home. Highly recommend Jaden and Cookies N Clean!

I wanted to recommend Daisha from mobile grooming.  She recently provided a spa treatment and grooming for my dogs and did a fantastic job with great care and professionalism.  If you need mobile grooming services, I highly recommend reaching out to her.
Tristan was great. Dog is happy and clean.  Pretty expensive with no haircut needed.
The absolute best wonderful service great job my dog loves Daisha❤️❤️❤️

Courtney was awesome and took care of our GSD with the upmost care
He looks and smells great
Sadie did an amazing job on Rocky! Thanks again

Went here today for the first time, and I was so impressed with the excellent customer service! My dog has a hard time being around other dogs, and they handled everything perfectly and made sure he was comfortable. He came out looking absolutely great! I definitely recommend coming here, and we will be back for sure!
Friendly service, awesome staff
we have an elderly 160 lb Saint Bernard and these people are just so gentle and amazing with her this is the only place she gets to go. we also have two golden retrievers that they do a wonderful job
Nail trim
They always do a great job! Barney comes out so cute and fluffy!
Everyone is very friendly and the results are 100 percent fabulous!
I like this place because you can do a walk in for nail services. I’m a guy and I am terrible at scheduling appointments so it is very convenient.
George looks great and groomer was very attentive to my wishes and very sweet
Tucker loved going to Cookies n Clean again for his bath, brush, and deshedding treatment . He looked so handsome when Sage was all done 🐶
They always do such a great job on all of our dogs.

I reached out to cookies n clean to try and get my cat in last minute due to a litter box mishap (caked on poo 🤢) and they unfortunately didn’t have anything immediately. They however responded with tips to get it done myself as I expressed that I would be doing it myself today if I couldn’t get him in anywhere cause I don’t want poo on my furniture lol. The tip they gave me (cut an Old sock and put the tubed end over the ears and head) made it incredibly easy and I got it done with no issues myself in very little time. It was incredibly kind of them to give me advice even though I would not be scheduling with them. Thank you!!!

Cookies N Clean has been an amazing addition to our routine. We have a large dog who doesn’t love the bath or the car, so we made the decision to find a mobile groomer. Cookies N Clean was among a select few that would take large dogs, and so we booked an appointment. Now we’re on a 4-week rotation and honestly, it’s the best decision we’ve ever made. The staff is amazing and their communication is top-notch. They text you throughout the day of your appointment and they send you pictures during. I would definitely recommend them to any pet owner!
Lily is always beautiful after Gabby grooms her!
My Coco (and, I) love Sage! I feel safe leaving her for her grooming. Some salons would not accept her because of her breed, but Cookies & Clean had no issues. I couldn't ask for more!
Great place to take your fur buddies!! So friendly and professional!!
They did an excellent job of bathing and blowing dry my very long-haired little dog. They also use very high quality products.
My pups Rico suave and ginger came out amazingly as usual!! My stylist sage did an absolutely amazing time; and even worked with me with a late drop off! Thanks everyone!!!

As always, Tristan does an amazing job! My fur babies love him!
Here a before and after photos. My baby husky is losing her coat. You can brush til the cows come home but the next day she’s lookin’ rough again. After Tristan though…she’s beautiful again! My lab needs a grooming’ because of the Husky’s snowfall all over the house. He looks beautiful now too! ❤️❤️

Absolutely my favorite place to take my cat for grooming! They are so wonderful and take great care for her each time she goes. They are amazing at staying on schedule and reminding you of upcoming appointments. I highly recommend!
Our groomer is amazing. The boys love her and are excited when they see her. All the staff is great and very friendly. I love this place

I brought in a cat that I had adopted from the streets and she was a mess. After her vet check I decided she needed some serious TLC. She was greasy, grimy and her coat was matted and thick. Kris at Cookies and Clean transformed her into a beautiful kitty. The white in her coat looked white instead of gray. She can groom herself now without vomiting from all of the fur and dirt that was on her. Kris is a cat lady so she is very gentle and understands the breed. What a positive experience and my kitty is like a new cat. I highly recommend Kris and Cookies and Clean.
Sage does an awesome job grooming my standard Goldendoodle, he looks great and comes out happy!

Everyone her is super nice and they care so much about the dogs. My dog Lizzy hates going in the car and to the groomers. She is a little old lady now. Honestly when she got here she was very calm. This is her fourth time getting groomed here. She always comes out looking gorgeous and the staff always explain what they do and if they see any problems.They take care of her especially as she is 14 and are so gentle with her. Lizzy says thanks and so does her Mum. Don’t hesitate going to Cookies and Clean 😊

Fun place, great groomers, and fair pricing. There's always cool products from local small businesses available. The groomers are friendly and do a great job. My pittie mix LOVES going and Tristen is his favorite. The prices are good. I appreciate that I can schedule and pay online.
Did a great job with our 2 frenchies. Thank you!
Kayla does a beautiful shihtzu cut.

They claim they can groom cats, so the mobile van came and they did the worst hack job on my Persian and charged an exuberant amount of money and labeled him as an aggressive animal and charged me a $25 fee without my knowledge because he acted like a cat! When I spoke to the owner to explain how terrible he looked he offered me to bring him in to get him fixed for a discounted rate. A discounted rate???? It should have been free, I already paid over $200

I’ve been coming here for years, my Australian Kelpie gets the full service groom that includes getting his teeth brushed, shampoo treatment, nails trimmed, and full grooming. The service is reasonably priced and all staff are professionals, caring and extremely considerate to my pet. My fur baby is Cyrus da Doog. He is terrified going in but he gets calmed by the loving staff here. Highly recommend this grooming facility. Experts at what they do!!
The young lady who took care of my very skittish poodle did an absolutely amazing job clipping my Standard Poodle.

Kris was SOOOOO good with our senior fur baby. Sandy felt right at home immediately (which says A LOT since she gave me issues just getting out of the car 😂) and left as the happiest little pup in the world! Can’t wait to take her back for her next spa day!
They always do a great job, and the staff is always friendly!
Courtney did an excellent job of grooming my poodle. She gave me exactly what I asked for, my dog looks great!
Excellent service and my pup always comes back so cute and fresh!

So incredibly clean, friendly and kind!! It was my first time there with the baby and she did sooo good getting her nails trimmed!! Just amazing people!!! Also got her an “I survived my nail trim” cookie and she LOVED it!!!
Kayla is fantastic and really has an eye and listens. My Kylo loves her!!

Gabbi is great with my long haired border collie, Dinah. She always makes her look beautiful. I appreciate her hard work on all the fur that Dinah has. Nice job…we are already booked for our next appointment! 🥰🐾

I got my cat groomed for the first time today and had the best experience! Jaden made me & Obi (cat) feel incredibly comfortable and stress free during the entire experience. Your fur babies are in good hands here:)
Cookies n clean does an amazing job on their grooming. Top notch! They are so good with my anxious dog. He always looks great!!!
Best place ever! We found our forever doggy grooming place 😍😍😍
Sage is the best!  She does such an awesome job on my little Oliver. ❤️
Jaden is super kind and friendly to my cat. Defiantly would like to take my cat back for grooming. ❤️❤️
They are very professional and always treat my pups with love and care. Very convenient hours for us that work regular business hours.
Tristan did a great job with Maya. We would highly recommend him and will definitely be coming back.
Tristian did a fantastic job on my Corgi. Will definitely be back.
Chris took such great care of my senior dog.
Great groomers!  They have the tables that raise up so no stress on our old dog.  We always leave with a pep in our step.
My groomer Sage did an impeccable job grooming my Cavalier King Charles.  I have already booked my next appointment.
The dogs look adorable.
My 2 dogs look great today!

I have been taking my dog Albus to see Courtney for about a year now and he LOVES her. My husband and I are so thankful we feel safe leaving our dogs with a groomer, and Courtney does such a phenomenal job every time! I’ve started pre booking my appointments with Courtney because she books up so fast. For a reason! We love her!!

My cat CJ had his first grooming. He is 14 years with arthritis. I rescued him during the pandemic and he's been my baby ever since.  CJ is afraid of most people so I have his vet visits at our house. He doesn't like to go anywhere. He started having a hard time bathing himself, so I had to find a groomer.  It wasn't easy, but we were so blessed to find Frankie.  She was so kind, gentle, and patient. CJ just loved her and so did I. He looked so beautiful after his two hour beauty treatment. He was so happy after he was all done. Cookies N Clean will always have my business. ❤️

Took my dogs in to get their nails trimmed and was very nervous about this experience. They don’t typically enjoy this process at all!

The groomers were extra polite and friendly and did a great job with both dogs to settle them down. Definitely recommend.
Santiago groomed my 3 babies and they looked and smelled great, and they were so HAPPY when they came out. We will definitely be returning! 100000000/10
We have a VERY anxious girl and Santi has been so good with her. We are very happy with our service here.
Grooming with Gabby!      Elektra looks so good after her groom.  I bring in a dirty doodle and Gabby makes her look perfect!

Cookies N Clean is a wonderful pet grooming service. My sister and I took our Mother's sweet little Terrier mix dog there for a bath, haircut, and had her nails trimmed. Our groomer was Courtney and her work is outstanding and caring! We highly recommend this pet grooming salon for your dogs and cats!

Walked in for self bathing our dog.
Owner is very friendly and professional.
Had a super sweet dog groomer trim his nails
She was calm and gentle with him.
Thank you a great experience
Jaden is the best cat trimmer that I have gone to at this place would highly recommend

I took our 1yr old mini goldendoodle Lainey in for her first haircut. Her hair was LONG and I wanted to keep the majority of her hair (did not want her shaved) and Kayla listened to what I was looking for in her groom today. Lainey came back looking so fluffy and cute and kept her floofy ponytail (with a new bow)!
I recommend bringing your pup here.
Thank you Santi! Bandit loved his grooming and pampering today! ❤️

Perfect, no issues, they always do a great job, best family groomer around! This was my old review, this is my new review 03/31/2026 at 12:56pm. My wife reaches out to me and tells me that our little Shih Tzus Grooming appointment was canceled and was rescheduled for another week out when we’ve been waiting  for at least 10 days now this appointment was canceled by text an hour and a half before it was time to drop our dog off and the reason behind it was the person who is supposed to do the grooming is sick. Now I understand issues can come up people call in sick, but what I don’t understand is why it was pushed back a week instead of rescheduling in the next day or two we have been coming here for years and it seems like the last year customer service And communication have gotten worse. I  myself am a business owner, and I find this being bad business. This is why we changed our review from a five star to a 1 star as we received this cancellation by text and not in the professional manner of a phone call. I advise that you guys find yourself a few more groomers if you guys are this busy and your customer service is falling. Thank you
Gabby did a fantastic job on our mini golden doodle. He is so happy to see Gabby to get groomed. Would highly recommend!!
Puppy looks great!
Have a 17 year old dog poor eye sight and hearing. They are always patient with her
I have my Danes nails done here. Very friendly.  I have recommended them to my parents. They are looking at washing their dog.

I had the greatest experience for the 1st. time in a long time (02/2026). Rebecca from Cookies & Clean on Moon Valley (13418 N. 7th. Street) did a fantastic job with my shih-Tzu princess Bella!. Rebecca is awesome!. 100% recommended!!!🙂🐾🌻🐾🌺🐾🌼🐾
Great service. Great work.

I had an appointment and had to cancel had a water line break in my home when I called I spoke with a young lady and she said no problem.

I happen to notice that I was billed 40.00 for canceling I asked to speak with a manager several times but all I got is that he is out of town. I even offered to show them the invoice from my plumber that didn’t work also, this is the same place that cancels on me all the time even once when I was driving up there.

I was givin an email but still have not heard back from anybody. I guess I will just let my home flood not very professional on your part won’t be back.
We take our mini dachshund here and he always comes back relaxed. Kayla did great with his nail trim today and Santi is always great with our pup as well!
Had mobile grooming for our cat. Had a great first experience, definitely recommend for mobile grooming service!
Fantastic service, my Paco loves them too
Everyone at Cookies N Clean helped to make my- and Ollie's- first visit super pleasant! Ollie looks incredible and I feel like I found our groomer going forward

The service was amazing and they treated my cat with so much care!  We used the Mobile grooming services and they were the best that we’ve come across in this area!  Thanks again, our baby looks great and he was in great hands!
Very convenient for do it yourself pup wash.  They always take good care of Bubba and Sissy. Thank you
Took my mother's dachshund to get his nails trimmed here and Santiago did an amazing job. Thank you so much!
Our two dogs looked great
Kayla was wonderful with Molly & Jasper

Frankie groomed our three dogs and did a truly magnificent job! She was so patient and kind, especially with our oldest dog who needs extra care and attention. You could tell she genuinely cared and took her time to make sure everyone was comfortable and well cared for. All three dogs look amazing, and the experience was stress-free from start to finish. I’ve already rebooked because we were that happy. We’re so glad we chose Cookies N Clean and will definitely be returning. Highly recommend Frankie! 🐾✨

Frankie did an absolutely wonderful job grooming our two Bernedoodles, Bernice and Mable. The mobile grooming experience made such a difference and was so much less stressful for the girls than a traditional grooming salon. Frankie was kind, patient, and incredibly skilled, and honestly, this is the best grooming they’ve ever had. They both look amazing, and I couldn’t be happier with how they turned out. I highly recommend Frankie and the mobile grooming service to anyone looking for top-notch care for their pups.

I’ve been taking my dog here for quite some time and I am very unhappy with the disregard to tell me they cut her badly on her ear and the clippers burned her upon pickup I was not informed of this or notified of it! It would be one thing if they notified me upon pickup that this happened but the fact they did not is uncalled for!
Forest loves Cookies N Clean and so do I. We are treated well and have been coming here for a couple of years now and I would not take him anywhere else 😀
Gabby did a great job on my doodle. She did exactly as I asked and she looks great! Thanks!!!

He got fully bathed and I don’t know what the girls name was this time but I do need to find out because she was amazing with him. This is the best he has ever smelled afterwards, he wasn’t a crazy dog coming back he was nice and calm etc. Today was the best experience that he’s had so far.
PLEASE THANK HER

I never actually got service from Cookies N Clean. I put down a deposit for mobile grooming but my appointment kept getting rescheduled by the groomer/ company. After a month of trying to schedule, the company stopped responding to my texts and an email. They never responded to my final attempt to reschedule or my request for my deposit back. Beware of giving them a deposit.
Ryan is fabulous!!

They were able to get his tear stains, and the groomer i took him to before wasn’t able to. I told Cookies n Clean to muzzle him if he gets crazy, and they were able to do him without a muzzle!! I am so impressed!!! They did him so amazing, I cannot wait to go back!
We are new here in town and was very pleased with the service and that we could get an appointment just in 2 days. Definitely will return for my Aussie Doddle spa day. 😊.

My 12lb doodle needed a bath and brush and Geri did everything perfectly and just like I requested and I can’t wait to come back for a full groom!! Thank you!! Also their prices are super reasonable and fair and you get great quality service for a great price! I’ll be back!!
Great groom and On Time
Everyone there is friendly. Gabby grooms my Golden Retriever and does a fabulous job!! Thank you Gabby.

Today12/19/2025 I had a mobile appointment for my two dogs at my house.  I was at an appointment this morning and left early to be home for the appointment.  When I got home I had a text canceling my appointment and they rescheduled it for the 23rd which we will not even be home.  This is not acceptable.  I called for the manager to call me and after 3 1/2 hours and no call I called again.  Again I was promised a call back from the manager and when he finally called back he said he fired the groomer this morning and he would try and get my two dogs an appointment.  His phone had so much static I could hardly understand him.  He dropped the call twice before texting me I would have to bring only one dog in on Monday the 22nd to be groomed at a location 30 minutes from my home.  This is beyond ridiculous and this is not the first time this company has cancelled my dogs appointment, this is the third time.  I would never recommend this company to anyone!  They don’t deserve any stars!!!!
New owners are nice and accommodating to my pups anxiety. Both of my pups walked out squeaky clean with smiles on their faces. The groomers are kind and gentle.
The groomer (Courtney) really listened to what I wanted done for my dog and did a perfect job. Additionally, she was able to get my nervous, timid  dog to relax. This 5 star rating was well earned!

This was my second visit, and unfortunately I was completely disappointed this time.
During my first visit, I was very satisfied with the bath and grooming, which is why I decided to come back.

Normally, when my dog gets a bath and haircut, it takes about an hour and a half before I receive a call that he’s ready. However, during this second visit, I got a call saying he was done only about 45 minutes after drop-off.

When I picked him up and took him home, it was hard to tell if he had even been groomed. It felt like he was only rinsed with water, and he still had an odor.

Additionally, they didn’t even put on the scarf that is usually provided after grooming, yet I was charged the same full price. Overall, this experience was very disappointing.

Cookies N Clean, we're so professional with my 14 week old poodle. She is nervous about people at this point. The groomer won my Sahara over within 2 minutes of being there. I was able to leave her with a worry. When I picked her up, she was happy and prancing like a little lady. I'll definitely be taking my poodle 🐩 back to this amazing place. I highly recommend them.
Been going here for several years, always pleased
The people are friendly. We never have to wait. They always take our dog right back. It's very clean. There's always putting in parking
Great experience every time! Bella is so fresh and so clean clean! ❤️

Victoria at Cookies and clean always puts forth care and diligence
. She is a talented professional.
Victoria did an awesome job. Always a great experience

Lisa was so patient with my dog who has been dealing with emotional trauma the last few weeks, first time in a mobile grooming van and the difficulty getting him moved around because he is such a big dog and he is old so he doesn't get around like he used to. I was very impressed with her
Frijole turned out so cute! Great service and he looks like a million bucks! Would highly recommend!

My entire experience with Cookies N Clean - from the time I initially called until my dog was groomed - has been amazing! This place and Sage came highly recommended and I definitely see why. Sage was so kind and caring and really took time to understand what I was wanting and my concerns. Prior to coming to Cookies N Clean we had some really bad experiences with groomers so I was really nervous. But everyone was so warm and welcoming and the atmosphere here is really inviting! Sage did an amazing job with my girl- we will def be back!
We love cookies n clean! They do a great job with our golden doodle!

Never even had a chance to see how the good a job they do. I booked an appointment to get my 2 dogs and 1 cat done through their mobile groomer. I needed to make a change and called the carefree number. Thought that was where I booked it to start with. I explained to the very rude lady that answered the phone. She about started yelling that I was calling the wrong number. She never offered the correct number and hung up on me. I looked again at the website. Found the mobile number and called it. They answered cookies n clean carefree again. The guy that answered was very nice and helped me cancel my appointment. The damage had already been done by the first person. I'm going else where.
They are always friendly and treat my pups with tender loving care. The pups always look fantastic when they are finished. I highly recommend them.
They were great, friendly, affordable, and my Golden retriever looks  beautiful :)
Excellent,  Tristan is great! Thank you.
Love this place. Sage is awesome!
Terrible experience during the self wash visit. No towels drying & bins were filthy. However, the staff was sweet and friendly.
Excellent local pet care spot. Staff is awesome. Self wash area has everything you need. SUPPORT LOCAL BUSINESS!!!

Best groomers ever. They take their time with my dog.  They are very patient with her when doing her nails.  She had a bad experience else where and hasn’t forgot about it.  She loves going to see Ashley.
My pug gets hers nails done here and the staff is always warm and amazing with her. They do a great job!

Our dog Everest absolutely loved it there. She came out looking the cleanest she’s ever been as an all white husky! The team there was extremely friendly and was knowledgable about what do with a huskies hair etc. We will definitely
be going back!

If I could give 0 stars I would. I set an appointment two weeks out, and the day of they text and call to have me switch for no reason given. ( I get it was halloween day, but should not matter, if they had plans or whatever don't let people schedule on holidays!) I do switch, and then they cancel the rescheduled appointment on me. Again I did them a favor by switching my first appointment. They can't even fit her in today at all? This is a very unprofessional place and I would not bring your dog here. Definitely don't except to have the appointment that you scheduled. - For how much you pay this place find somewhere else that is actually professional and affordable.

Such a great place! I took my pup for the self service wash, he was a little anxious but the staff were wonderful! They helped make him feel at ease. It’s very clean, and they had everything you could need (shampoo, conditioner, towels, air dryer). It was amazing
Things have gone downhill. Price fir a self dog wash has continued to rise, now ~$25. The stalls are shabby and run down

I’ll be taking my business elsewhere moving forward. My first service with them was phenomenal, but every experience since then has been disappointing. When I scheduled my second service, it took days for them to even respond, but I still decided to give them another chance.

For my most recent appointment on 09/11, they confirmed the booking but never gave me a time. On the day of, no one showed up. When I reached out, they claimed they came at 1:14 pm, knocked on my door, and even texted me—but none of that actually happened. I was home the entire day, and I never received any message or confirmation.

Between the lack of communication and the dishonesty, I can’t continue doing business with them.

Nice place.  Very easy going folks.  Danielle takes great care of my dog.  Reasonable pricing.  Pretty close to a 2 hour turnaround.  Good communication.  Huge lobby.  Great parking.  Highly recommend over the other cageless facility close by.

Sept 2025:  We used several different groomers since above review due to circumstances. We decided to go back to CnC. Good decision. Never should have left. So much better on all issues. Financial, convenience, quality, easy process and just a good business!!
Sage made my dog look great! My dog is normally nervous at the groomer but she came out happy and relaxed. Everyone is very friendly and I will be returning for future visits.

We took our Fluffy in to this place I horrified by the
Way they treated her, I'm sorry Candice I told you
I wouldn't give you a bad rating, but after thinking bout it I decided I needed to!!!you guys need to be more
Careful in the future so you don't make another
Family's best friend bleed from being in a hurry
And arguing with another employee!!need to be
More professional!!!!!!
The staff were so sensitive to our dogs fears. At the finish, he gave staff a kiss. It says it all.

I had an appointment with Tristan to get my cats nails trimmed at 8 a.m. which I needed to keep because I had to drop him and run to my cycle class at 8:15. When I showed up the girl at the front was like oh Tristan doesn't do cats. I said, I have an appointment, she was like I'll go ask him, she came right back and was like oh no he doesn't do that but I can get you an appointment with our cat groomer on Monday. So I drove all the way over to the groomer, missed my cycle class and was treated like dirt, like it was no big deal. So I turned around and walked out not saying anything because I wanted to cry for making me go through all that and the receptionist girl snively said: Have a nice day as I exited. Like I was dirt and my time was worth nothing. Horrible customer service.
Very clean and professional environment to get your animals cut, cleaned and bathed, i was impressed by the facility and staff. Will be taking all our animals here when ready!

Took my dog in for a full grooming session and they did a amazing job. Her fur was soft and fluffy and they even tied a cute bandana around her neck. The groomer asked what style I wanted and made sure not to cut too short which some places do. My dog usually hates grooming but she came out happy and wagging her tail. The place was super clean and didn’t smell like wet dog like most grooming shops. Only thing was I had to wait a week to get in so book early. Price was fair and worth it for how good she looked and smelled after. They even trimmed her nails and cleaned her ears. I’ll definitely bring her back here again. You can tell they really love animals and do careful work. Highly recommend for anyone who wants their dog treated well.
The staff were friendly and attentive. They were patient with my pup and did a great job grooming her! We will definitely be back!
The staff were attentive and friendly. They did a wonderful job grooming my pup! We will definitely be back!
Gabriella did a fantastic job with our dog. He's all nice and pretty again.
Gabby was very good with our Zeke along with Maryn who Zeke LOVED!  She's his regular now!
Thanks for the 5-star rating, Athena! Every review makes a big difference.

We simply do not have enough wonderful words of praise for Victoria!  Her genuine kindness, love and gentle care for our very senior chocolate lab during each appointment is a gift we do not take for granted.   Hats off to you Victoria for always going above and beyond.!  Our family is so very thankful for you!
Cookies and Clean has always done a great job for our dog. Tristan is super friendly and our dog seems to really like him.

Very personable.  They listen to requests and are willing to fix any issues (if any) upon pick up.  Great with my dog.  They are efficient as well as service is usually exactly how long they quote.  I travel 20 minutes to get Cali groomed here and there are definitely closer options.  Highly recommend.
Always does a great job and makes you feel comfortable to leave your dog with them! Great variety of chews and toys as well.
Excellent 5 star service. It was great that all 3 pups could be done at the same time and communication was great. My pups look gorgeous and definitely cooler after deshedding service.
